hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' || exit 0; npx tsc --noEmit
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' || exit 0; npx eslint --fix "$path"
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -q 'schema.prisma' || exit 0; npx prisma format && npx prisma validate
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.env' && echo 'Blocked: cannot edit .env files directly' && exit 1 || exit 0
